PresetBar.tooltip: Load a factory or saved preset; type a name and press Save to store the current state

SystemBrowser.tooltip: 94 strange-attractor systems. Type to search, click the star to pin favorites (saved with the session), click a name to select

Slider.caption: Morph
Slider.tooltip: Crossfade time when switching systems (milliseconds)

ComboBox.caption: Morph

ToggleButton.tooltip: Morph time follows the host tempo instead of milliseconds

ComboBox.caption: Solver
ComboBox.tooltip: Auto uses the exact closed form where one exists (pendulum in libration), numerical otherwise

ComboBox.caption: On Blow-Up
ComboBox.tooltip: Reset re-seeds the attractor when it diverges (riser then clean restart); Free/Clamp lets it ride and hard-limits

PhaseScope.tooltip: Attractor trajectory (x vs y) — this exact curve is what modulates filter, tremolo and pan

Slider.tooltip: THE knob: walks the bifurcation terrain below — gray fixed point, green limit cycle (sync-able), amber chaos, red blow-up

RegimeStrip.tooltip: Regime terrain of the selected system: gray fixed, green periodic, amber chaos, red divergent. Click or drag to jump the Macro

RegimeReadout.tooltip: Selected system, current regime, largest Lyapunov exponent, native period and host tempo
